selection: Rank SHA256(seed + | + problem_id) within each stratum; no correctness/length filtering.
rationale: Hold the fast-IS search settings fixed to examine the C-versus-SC writing tendency; other search variants assessed by all-problem identity/length data and illustrative original traces.

exploration.0: One approach; only perfunctory dismissal of naive method
exploration.1: Substantive comparison or revision of two approaches
exploration.2: Sustained branching among approaches/state designs or repeated route changes

revisiting.0: No material return to a settled step

walkthrough.2: Detailed step-by-step simulation or multiple prolonged checks

implementation.0: Conceptual plan, no extended draft/representation discussion
implementation.1: One substantive code draft or implementation discussion
implementation.2: Multiple code drafts or sustained representation/performance/edge-case engineering discussion

closure.0: Settles on an approach with an ordinary ending
closure.2: Text breaks off mid-derivation or mid-code

procedure: Read full thinking; exact common-prefix references allowed only within the pair. Record semantic codes and short text-grounded notes before revealing mode mapping. No keyword-count classification.
limits: One assistant reviewer; exploratory fixed sample, not an independent multi-rater study. Counts apply to sample, not population prevalence. Formatting/length are not reasoning quality.
